cl:7W6cAAWHutxh7BwBJCNAgG.title: 2015 Honda Civic LX-Clean Title-Low Miles
cl:7W6cAAWHutxh7BwBJCNAgG.description: It truly saddens us to part ways with our beloved, garage-kept 2015 Honda Civic LX. It has been meticulously maintained, driven below-average miles for its age, and kept in excellent condition. However, with our family growing, we now need something larger. I am confident this is one of the cleanest examples you will find on the market! This Civic has been exceptionally well cared for, with all services and maintenance fully up to date and performed according to Katy Honda's recommended maintenance schedule. Recent maintenance includes a fresh oil change, transmission fluid change, and brake service. Clean Texas title in hand, ready to be signed over to its next lucky owner. The vehicle has never been involved in any accidents. This Civic comes equipped with great features, including a backup camera, cruise control, Bluetooth connectivity, AUX and USB ports, keyless entry, remote trunk release, and many other convenient features to enhance your driving experience. The Urban Titanium Metallic exterior is in excellent condition for its age, with nothing out of the ordinary for an 11-year-old vehicle. The beige cloth interior is equally well maintained and still looks and smells like new, as shown in the pictures. The tires are in excellent condition, nitrogen-filled, equipped with wheel locks, and covered by a road hazard warranty through Discount Tire. The vehicle runs and drives exceptionally well, with absolutely no issues! It is an excellent gas saver, delivering more than 35 MPG, and features ECO mode to help maximize fuel efficiency. It also offers plenty of cargo space, with rear seats that fold down to provide additional room when needed. Included with the vehicle are two original key fobs, along with all the original books and owner's manuals. The price is $10,800 CASH – FIRM. The first serious buyer ready to pay the full asking price gets it! I will not hold the vehicle, so please be prepared to complete the purchase if you are genuinely interested. It is priced to sell and well below dealer pricing. It is becoming increasingly difficult to find a Civic, known for its outstanding reliability and comfort, this clean, reliable, well-equipped, and meticulously maintained at this price! This would make an excellent first car for your kids or a dependable daily driver! You are more than welcome to bring your own mechanic for an independent inspection. I know what I have, and this vehicle is truly in excellent condition. The VIN is posted in the ad for anyone who would like to run a vehicle history report. Feel free to call or text me at show contact info . If I am unable to answer your call, please send me a text, and I will get back to you as soon as possible. Thanks for looking!
